description: This script generates firmware images and upgrade scripts for Linksys switches in the OpenWrt project. It creates various scripts and configuration files, packages them into a tar archive, and handles specific hardware models based on input parameters.

methods.name: gen_imagecheck
methods.description: Generates a shell script to check if the image matches the hardware model based on input parameter.

methods.name: gen_fwinfo
methods.description: Outputs firmware version and boot version information.

methods.name: gen_nor_upgrade
methods.description: Creates a script to upgrade firmware to NOR flash, installing only to the first partition.

methods.name: gen_nand_upgrade
methods.description: Creates a script to upgrade firmware to NAND flash, installing only to the first partition.
